capabilities.name: Read-only repository inspection
capabilities.activation: A fresh agent needs current branch, worktree, commit, remote, or PR evidence.
capabilities.description: Collect current repository evidence: branch state, commits, worktrees, open PRs, and file snapshots without mutation.

capabilities.name: PR comparison and collision inspection
capabilities.activation: Two or more active branches, pull requests, or planned sprint lanes touch a shared or high-risk surface.
capabilities.description: Inspect open pull requests and planned sprint ownership against base main, identify shared surfaces, and produce a deterministic collision ledger.
guardrails: do not infer local worktree state from GitHub alone

capabilities.name: Validator selection
capabilities.activation: A run context or working tree has changed paths and requires a targeted validation plan.
capabilities.description: Choose validators from the registry based on changed paths and workflow, include declared prerequisites, and fail conservatively for unmapped paths. Selection never executes commands.
guardrails: missing path mappings use the conservative fallback

capabilities.name: Deployment candidate assembly
capabilities.activation: Repository-only deployment repairs are ready to converge on current main.
capabilities.description: Build a controlled deployment candidate from current main by converging owned, non-conflicting changes. Requires explicit authorization for live surfaces.

capabilities.name: Local production certification
capabilities.activation: A current, green candidate SHA requires disposable local production-mode certification.
capabilities.description: Run a disposable local production-mode certification against a candidate SHA, then emit GO/NO-GO with bounded evidence.
guardrails: clean only resources created by the run

capabilities.name: Runtime-proof recording
capabilities.activation: A deployment-related command or observation must be recorded against a proof ceiling.
capabilities.description: Validate sanitized commands, timestamps, assertions, failures, and attained proof levels in the runtime-proof schema.

capabilities.name: Backup and restore local certification
capabilities.activation: Operator or automated pipeline requests proof of local synthetic backup round-trip and non-mutation.
capabilities.description: Execute synthetic account backup generation, local store verification, dry-run non-mutation, and synthetic restore to prove backup integrity.
guardrails: operate on disposable or synthetic targets only
